title: Neo Soul
tagline: Soul traditions revisited through contemporary grooves and personal songwriting.
summary: Neo soul emerged in the 1990s as singers and musicians reconnected contemporary R&B with classic soul, jazz, and hip-hop. Warm live instrumentation, expressive vocals, and personal writing became common features, though the style varies widely. Its artists helped broaden R&B beyond polished radio conventions.

pillars.name: Erykah Badu
pillars.why: Badu's distinctive voice and jazz-inflected arrangements made her a defining figure of neo soul.

pillars.name: D'Angelo
pillars.why: D'Angelo brought deep grooves, live-band interplay, and classic soul references into a modern R&B framework.

pillars.name: Jill Scott
pillars.why: Scott's songwriting and vocal delivery helped establish neo soul's intimate, poetic approach.
